require_relative 'headers'

module Addresses
  class Invalid < StandardError; end

  class Parser
    def initialize(tokens)
      @tokens = tokens
      @index = 0
      @encoded_error = false
    end

    def parse
      result = [address(false)]
      while kind == ','
        @index += 1
        result << address(false)
      end
      raise Invalid unless @index == @tokens.length

      [result, @encoded_error]
    end

    private

    def kind
      @tokens[@index]&.kind
    end

    def take(expected)
      raise Invalid unless kind == expected

      @index += 1
    end

    def phrase(kinds)
      start = @index
      @index += 1 while kinds.include?(kind)
      @tokens[start...@index]
    end

    def valid_part?(tokens)
      !tokens.empty? && tokens.length.odd? && tokens.each_with_index.all? do |token, index|
        token.kind == (index.even? ? :word : '.')
      end
    end

    def display_name(tokens)
      text = +''
      previous_success = false
      tokens.each_with_index do |token, index|
        decoded, success, error = token.kind == :word ? Headers.encoded_word(token.text) : [token.text, false, false]
        text << ' ' if index.positive? && token.spaced && !(previous_success && success)
        text << decoded
        previous_success = success
        @encoded_error ||= error
      end
      name = Headers.collapse(text)
      name.empty? ? nil : name
    end

    def address(inside_group)
      name_tokens = phrase([:word, :quoted, '.'])
      case kind
      when '<'
        take('<')
        local = phrase([:word, '.'])
        take('@')
        domain = phrase([:word, '.'])
        take('>')
        name = display_name(name_tokens)
      when '@'
        local = name_tokens
        take('@')
        domain = phrase([:word, '.'])
        name = nil
      when ':'
        raise Invalid if inside_group || name_tokens.empty?

        take(':')
        members = []
        unless kind == ';'
          members << address(true)
          while kind == ','
            take(',')
            members << address(true)
          end
        end
        take(';')
        return { kind: :group, members: members }
      else
        raise Invalid
      end
      raise Invalid unless valid_part?(local) && valid_part?(domain)

      address = (local.map(&:text).join + '@' + domain.map(&:text).join).downcase
      { kind: :mailbox, address: address, name: name }
    end
  end

  def self.parse(text)
    tokens = Headers.tokens(text, :address)
    return nil unless tokens && !tokens.empty?

    Parser.new(tokens).parse
  rescue Invalid
    nil
  end
end

require_relative 'headers'

module Dates
  MONTHS = %w[jan feb mar apr may jun jul aug sep oct nov dec].freeze
  WEEKDAYS = %w[mon tue wed thu fri sat sun].freeze
  ZONES = { 'ut' => 0, 'gmt' => 0, 'z' => 0, 'est' => -300, 'edt' => -240,
            'cst' => -360, 'cdt' => -300, 'mst' => -420, 'mdt' => -360,
            'pst' => -480, 'pdt' => -420 }.freeze

  def self.leap?(year)
    ((year % 4).zero? && !(year % 100).zero?) || (year % 400).zero?
  end

  def self.month_length(year, month)
    return leap?(year) ? 29 : 28 if month == 2

    [4, 6, 9, 11].include?(month) ? 30 : 31
  end

  def self.parse(text)
    stripped = Headers.remove_comments(text)
    return [nil, 'bad Date syntax'] unless stripped

    tokens = stripped.gsub(',', ' , ').scan(/[^ \t]+/)
    weekday = nil
    if tokens.length >= 3 && WEEKDAYS.include?(tokens[0].downcase) && tokens[1] == ','
      weekday = WEEKDAYS.index(tokens.shift.downcase)
      tokens.shift
    end
    return [nil, 'bad Date syntax'] unless tokens.length == 5

    day_text, month_text, year_text, time_text, zone_text = tokens
    month_index = MONTHS.index(month_text.downcase)
    clock = time_text.split(':', -1)
    numeric_zone = zone_text.match?(/\A[+-][0-9]{4}\z/)
    syntax_valid = day_text.match?(/\A[0-9]{1,2}\z/) && month_index &&
                   year_text.match?(/\A(?:[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4})\z/) &&
                   [2, 3].include?(clock.length) && clock.all? { |part| part.match?(/\A[0-9]{2}\z/) } &&
                   (numeric_zone || ZONES.key?(zone_text.downcase))
    return [nil, 'bad Date syntax'] unless syntax_valid

    day = day_text.to_i
    month = month_index + 1
    year = year_text.to_i
    year += year < 50 ? 2000 : 1900 if year_text.length == 2
    hour, minute, second = clock.map(&:to_i)
    second ||= 0
    if numeric_zone
      zone_hour = zone_text[1, 2].to_i
      zone_minute = zone_text[3, 2].to_i
      return [nil, 'Date out of range'] if zone_hour > 23 || zone_minute > 59

      offset = zone_hour * 60 + zone_minute
      offset = -offset if zone_text.start_with?('-')
    else
      offset = ZONES.fetch(zone_text.downcase)
    end
    return [nil, 'Date out of range'] unless year.between?(1970, 2099) &&
                                            day.between?(1, month_length(year, month)) &&
                                            hour <= 23 && minute <= 59 && second <= 59

    days = day - 1
    (1970...year).each { |prior| days += leap?(prior) ? 366 : 365 }
    (1...month).each { |prior| days += month_length(year, prior) }
    seconds = days * 86_400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second - offset * 60
    return [nil, 'Date out of range'] if seconds.negative?
    return [nil, 'Date weekday mismatch'] if weekday && (days + 3) % 7 != weekday

    [seconds, nil]
  end

  def self.notation(seconds)
    days, remainder = seconds.divmod(86_400)
    year = 1970
    while days >= (leap?(year) ? 366 : 365)
      days -= leap?(year) ? 366 : 365
      year += 1
    end
    month = 1
    while days >= month_length(year, month)
      days -= month_length(year, month)
      month += 1
    end
    format('%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d', year, month, days + 1,
           remainder / 3600, (remainder % 3600) / 60, remainder % 60)
  end
end

require_relative 'mime'

module Headers
  Token = Data.define(:kind, :text, :spaced)
  ADDRESS_MARKS = %q(!#$%&'*+-/=?^_`{|}~)
  MIME_EXCLUDED = [40, 41, 60, 62, 64, 44, 59, 58, 92, 34, 47, 91, 93, 63, 61].freeze

  def self.trim(text)
    text.gsub(/\A[ \t]+|[ \t]+\z/, '')
  end

  def self.collapse(text)
    trim(text.gsub(/[ \t]+/, ' '))
  end

  def self.fields(lines)
    fields = []
    invalid = []
    current = nil
    lines.each do |number, line|
      if line.start_with?(' ', "\t")
        if current
          current[1] << line
        else
          invalid << number
        end
        next
      end
      colon = line.index(':')
      if colon && colon.positive? && line[0...colon].each_byte.all? { |byte| byte.between?(33, 126) }
        current = [line[0...colon].downcase, line[colon + 1..]]
        fields << current
      else
        current = nil
        invalid << number
      end
    end
    fields.each { |field| field[1] = trim(field[1]) }
    [fields, invalid]
  end

  def self.remove_comments(text)
    result = +''
    depth = 0
    index = 0
    while index < text.length
      character = text[index]
      if depth.zero?
        if character == '('
          depth = 1
          result << ' '
        else
          result << character
        end
      elsif character == '\\'
        index += 1
      elsif character == '('
        depth += 1
      elsif character == ')'
        depth -= 1
      end
      index += 1
    end
    depth.zero? ? result : nil
  end

  def self.word_byte?(byte, variant)
    if variant == :address
      byte.between?(65, 90) || byte.between?(97, 122) || byte.between?(48, 57) ||
        ADDRESS_MARKS.include?(byte.chr)
    else
      byte.between?(33, 126) && !MIME_EXCLUDED.include?(byte)
    end
  end

  def self.tokens(text, variant)
    specials = variant == :address ? '<>:;@,.' : '/;='
    result = []
    index = 0
    spaced = false
    while index < text.length
      byte = text.getbyte(index)
      if byte == 32 || byte == 9
        spaced = true
        index += 1
        next
      end
      if byte == 40
        depth = 1
        index += 1
        while index < text.length && depth.positive?
          case text.getbyte(index)
          when 92 then index += 1
          when 40 then depth += 1
          when 41 then depth -= 1
          end
          index += 1
        end
        return nil unless depth.zero?

        spaced = true
        next
      end
      if byte == 34
        value = +''
        index += 1
        while index < text.length && text.getbyte(index) != 34
          if text.getbyte(index) == 92
            index += 1
            return nil if index == text.length
          end
          value << text[index]
          index += 1
        end
        return nil if index == text.length

        index += 1
        kind = :quoted
      elsif specials.include?(text[index])
        value = text[index]
        kind = value
        index += 1
      elsif word_byte?(byte, variant)
        first = index
        index += 1 while index < text.length && word_byte?(text.getbyte(index), variant)
        value = text[first...index]
        kind = :word
      else
        return nil
      end
      result << Token.new(kind, value, spaced)
      spaced = false
    end
    result
  end

  def self.encoded_word(word)
    return [word, false, false] unless word.length >= 4 && word.start_with?('=?') && word.end_with?('?=')

    pieces = word[2...-2].split('?', -1)
    return [word, false, false] unless pieces.length == 3 && pieces.none?(&:empty?)

    charset, encoding, text = pieces
    return [word, false, true] unless charset.downcase == 'us-ascii' && %w[Q q B b].include?(encoding)

    if encoding.downcase == 'b'
      decoded = Mime.strict_base64(text)
    else
      decoded = +''.b
      index = 0
      while index < text.length
        case text.getbyte(index)
        when 95
          decoded << 32
        when 61
          pair = text[index + 1, 2]
          return [word, false, true] unless pair&.match?(/\A[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}\z/)

          decoded << pair.to_i(16)
          index += 2
        else
          decoded << text.getbyte(index)
        end
        index += 1
      end
    end
    return [word, false, true] unless decoded && decoded.each_byte.all? { |byte| byte.between?(32, 126) }

    [decoded, true, false]
  end

  def self.unstructured(text)
    result = +''
    previous_success = false
    error = false
    text.scan(/[^ \t]+/).each_with_index do |word, index|
      decoded, success, failed = encoded_word(word)
      result << ' ' if index.positive? && !(previous_success && success)
      result << decoded
      previous_success = success
      error ||= failed
    end
    [collapse(result), error]
  end

  def self.parameters(text, subtype:)
    sequence = tokens(text, :mime)
    return nil unless sequence && sequence[0]&.kind == :word

    type = sequence[0].text.downcase
    index = 1
    sub = nil
    if subtype
      return nil unless sequence[index]&.kind == '/' && sequence[index + 1]&.kind == :word

      sub = sequence[index + 1].text.downcase
      index += 2
    end
    parameters = {}
    while index < sequence.length
      return nil unless sequence[index]&.kind == ';' && sequence[index + 1]&.kind == :word &&
                        sequence[index + 2]&.kind == '=' && [:word, :quoted].include?(sequence[index + 3]&.kind)

      name = sequence[index + 1].text.downcase
      parameters[name] = sequence[index + 3].text unless parameters.key?(name)
      index += 4
    end
    [type, sub, parameters]
  end
end

require 'fileutils'
require_relative 'headers'
require_relative 'addresses'
require_relative 'mime'
require_relative 'dates'
require_relative 'threader'

module MailboxProgram
  DUPLICATE_NAMES = %w[From To Cc Subject Date Message-ID In-Reply-To References
                       MIME-Version Content-Type Content-Transfer-Encoding Content-Disposition].freeze
  HTML_PARAGRAPHS = %w[p div ul ol table tr blockquote h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6].freeze
  HTML_REFERENCES = { 'amp' => '&', 'lt' => '<', 'gt' => '>', 'quot' => '"',
                      'apos' => "'", 'nbsp' => ' ' }.freeze

  def self.read_mailbox
    messages = []
    lines = File.binread('input/mailbox.mbox').split("\n", -1)
    lines.pop
    lines.each_with_index do |line, index|
      if line.start_with?('From ')
        messages << []
      else
        line = line[1..] if line.match?(/\A>+From /)
        messages.last << [index + 1, line]
      end
    end
    messages.each do |message|
      message.pop if !message.empty? && message.last[1].empty?
    end
    messages
  end

  def self.sections(lines)
    separator = lines.index { |_, text| text.empty? }
    separator ? [lines[0...separator], lines[separator + 1..]] : [lines, []]
  end

  def self.first_fields(fields)
    result = {}
    fields.each { |name, value| result[name] = value unless result.key?(name) }
    result
  end

  def self.well_formed_id?(text)
    return false unless text.length >= 3 && text.start_with?('<') && text.end_with?('>')

    inside = text[1...-1]
    inside.count('@') == 1 && !inside.start_with?('@') && !inside.end_with?('@') &&
      inside.each_byte.all? { |byte| byte.between?(33, 126) && ![60, 62, 40, 41, 34, 92].include?(byte) }
  end

  def self.extract_ids(text)
    result = []
    index = 0
    while (first = text.index('<', index))
      last = text.index('>', first + 1)
      break unless last

      candidate = text[first..last]
      result << candidate if well_formed_id?(candidate)
      index = last + 1
    end
    result
  end

  def self.parse_message(lines, number, accepted)
    header_lines, body = sections(lines)
    fields, invalid = Headers.fields(header_lines)
    values = first_fields(fields)
    problems = invalid.map { |line| "bad header line #{line}" }
    counts = fields.map(&:first).tally
    DUPLICATE_NAMES.each do |name|
      problems << "duplicate #{name}" if counts.fetch(name.downcase, 0) >= 2
    end
    message = { number: number, id: '', sender: nil, to: [], cc: [], date: nil, problems: problems }
    if !values.key?('from')
      problems << 'missing From'
    else
      parsed = Addresses.parse(values['from'])
      if !parsed || parsed[0].length != 1 || parsed[0][0][:kind] == :group
        problems << 'bad From'
      else
        message[:sender] = parsed[0][0]
        problems << 'bad encoded word in From' if parsed[1]
      end
    end
    %w[To Cc].each do |name|
      field = name.downcase
      next unless values.key?(field)

      parsed = Addresses.parse(values[field])
      if parsed
        recipients = []
        parsed[0].each do |address|
          if address[:kind] == :mailbox
            recipients << address[:address]
          else
            address[:members].each { |member| recipients << member[:address] }
          end
        end
        message[field.to_sym] = recipients
        problems << "bad encoded word in #{name}" if parsed[1]
      else
        problems << "bad #{name}"
      end
    end
    subject, encoded_error = Headers.unstructured(values.fetch('subject', ''))
    message[:subject] = subject
    problems << 'bad encoded word in Subject' if encoded_error
    base = subject
    reply = false
    while base[0, 3].downcase == 're:'
      base = base[3..].sub(/\A +/, '')
      reply = true
    end
    message[:base_subject] = base
    message[:reply] = reply
    if values.key?('date')
      message[:date], problem = Dates.parse(values['date'])
      problems << problem if problem
    else
      problems << 'missing Date'
    end
    id = values['message-id']
    if id.nil?
      problems << 'missing Message-ID'
    elsif !well_formed_id?(id)
      problems << 'bad Message-ID'
    elsif accepted.key?(id)
      problems << "Message-ID already used by message #{accepted[id][:number]}"
    else
      message[:id] = id
      accepted[id] = message
    end
    references = extract_ids(values.fetch('references', ''))
    in_reply_to = extract_ids(values.fetch('in-reply-to', '')).first
    references << in_reply_to if in_reply_to && references.last != in_reply_to
    message[:refs] = references
    enabled = false
    if values.key?('mime-version')
      version = Headers.remove_comments(values['mime-version'])
      if version && version.delete(" \t") == '1.0'
        enabled = true
      else
        problems << 'bad MIME-Version'
      end
    end
    message[:entity] = parse_entity('1', values, body, enabled, problems)
    message[:key] = [message[:date] ? 0 : 1, message[:date] || 0, message[:id], number]
    message
  end

  def self.parse_entity(part, values, body, enabled, problems)
    type = 'text'
    subtype = 'plain'
    parameters = {}
    if enabled && values.key?('content-type')
      parsed = Headers.parameters(values['content-type'], subtype: true)
      if parsed
        type, subtype, parameters = parsed
      else
        problems << "bad Content-Type in part #{part}"
      end
    end
    disposition = nil
    filename = nil
    if enabled && values.key?('content-disposition')
      parsed = Headers.parameters(values['content-disposition'], subtype: false)
      if parsed
        disposition = parsed[0]
        filename = parsed[2]['filename']
      else
        problems << "bad Content-Disposition in part #{part}"
      end
    end
    filename = parameters['name'] if filename.nil? || filename.empty?
    if type == 'text' && parameters.key?('charset') && parameters['charset'].downcase != 'us-ascii'
      problems << "unsupported charset \"#{parameters['charset'].downcase}\" in part #{part}"
    end
    entity = { part: part, type: type, subtype: subtype, parameters: parameters,
               disposition: disposition, filename: filename, children: nil, content: '' }
    if enabled && type == 'multipart'
      boundary = parameters['boundary']
      if boundary.nil? || boundary.empty?
        problems << "missing boundary in part #{part}"
      else
        parts = []
        closed = false
        body.each do |line|
          text = line[1].sub(/[ \t]+\z/, '')
          if text == "--#{boundary}--"
            closed = true
            break
          elsif text == "--#{boundary}"
            parts << []
          elsif !parts.empty?
            parts.last << line
          end
        end
        if parts.empty?
          problems << "no parts in part #{part}"
        elsif !closed
          problems << "unterminated multipart in part #{part}"
        end
        entity[:children] = []
        parts.each_with_index do |lines, index|
          header_lines, child_body = sections(lines)
          fields, invalid = Headers.fields(header_lines)
          invalid.each { |line| problems << "bad header line #{line}" }
          child = parse_entity("#{part}.#{index + 1}", first_fields(fields), child_body, true, problems)
          entity[:children] << child
        end
        return entity
      end
    end
    original = body.map { |_, text| text }.join("\n")
    encoding = enabled ? values.fetch('content-transfer-encoding', '7bit').downcase : '7bit'
    content = original
    case encoding
    when 'base64'
      content = Mime.base64_body(original)
      unless content
        problems << "bad base64 in part #{part}"
        content = ''
      end
    when 'quoted-printable'
      content, error = Mime.quoted_printable(original)
      problems << "bad quoted-printable in part #{part}" if error
    when '7bit', '8bit', 'binary'
      content = original
    else
      problems << "unknown encoding \"#{encoding}\" in part #{part}"
    end
    entity[:content] = content
    entity
  end

  def self.text_parts(entity, allow_html)
    children = entity[:children]
    unless children
      return [] if entity[:disposition] == 'attachment' || entity[:type] != 'text'
      return [entity] if entity[:subtype] == 'plain' || (allow_html && entity[:subtype] == 'html')

      return []
    end
    if entity[:subtype] == 'alternative'
      [false, true].each do |html|
        children.each do |child|
          result = text_parts(child, html)
          return result unless result.empty?
        end
      end
      []
    else
      children.flat_map { |child| text_parts(child, allow_html) }
    end
  end

  def self.wrap(text, prefix)
    lines = []
    current = +''
    text.scan(/[^ \t]+/).each do |word|
      if !current.empty? && current.length + 1 + word.length > 72
        lines << prefix + current
        current = word.dup
      else
        current << ' ' unless current.empty?
        current << word
      end
    end
    lines << prefix + current
    lines
  end

  def self.flowed(content, parameters)
    return [] if content.empty?

    logical = []
    delete_space = parameters.fetch('delsp', '').downcase == 'yes'
    content.split("\n", -1).each do |line|
      depth = 0
      depth += 1 while line.getbyte(depth) == 62
      text = line[depth..]
      text = text[1..] if text.start_with?(' ')
      flows = text.end_with?(' ') && text != '-- '
      if !logical.empty? && logical.last[2] && logical.last[0] == depth
        logical.last[1] = logical.last[1][0...-1] if delete_space
        logical.last[1] << text
        logical.last[2] = flows
      else
        logical << [depth, text, flows]
      end
    end
    logical.flat_map do |depth, text, _|
      prefix = depth.positive? ? '>' * depth + ' ' : ''
      wrap(text, prefix)
    end
  end

  def self.character_references(text)
    result = +''
    index = 0
    while index < text.length
      if text.getbyte(index) == 38 && (last = text.index(';', index + 1))
        name = text[index + 1...last]
        replacement = HTML_REFERENCES[name]
        if replacement.nil? && name.match?(/\A#[0-9]{1,3}\z/)
          value = name[1..].to_i
          replacement = value.chr if value.between?(32, 126)
        end
        if replacement
          result << replacement
          index = last + 1
          next
        end
      end
      result << text[index]
      index += 1
    end
    result
  end

  def self.html_lines(content)
    rows = []
    current = +''
    depth = 0
    hide = nil
    index = 0
    while index < content.length
      if content.getbyte(index) == 60 && (last = content.index('>', index + 1))
        inside = content[index + 1...last]
        ending = inside.start_with?('/')
        inside = inside[1..] if ending
        name = inside[/\A[A-Za-z0-9]*/].downcase
        index = last + 1
        if hide
          hide = nil if ending && name == hide
        elsif !ending && %w[head style script].include?(name)
          hide = name
        elsif name == 'br' || (name == 'li' && !ending)
          rows << [depth, current]
          current = name == 'li' ? +'* ' : +''
        elsif HTML_PARAGRAPHS.include?(name)
          rows << [depth, current]
          rows << [depth, '']
          current = +''
          if name == 'blockquote'
            depth = ending ? [0, depth - 1].max : depth + 1
          end
        end
      else
        current << content[index] unless hide
        index += 1
      end
    end
    rows << [depth, current]
    display = []
    rows.each do |quote_depth, text|
      collapsed = Headers.trim(text.gsub(/[ \t\n]+/, ' '))
      restored = character_references(collapsed).gsub(/\A +| +\z/, '')
      if restored.empty?
        display << '' if !display.empty? && !display.last.empty?
      else
        prefix = quote_depth.positive? ? '>' * quote_depth + ' ' : ''
        display.concat(wrap(restored, prefix))
      end
    end
    display.pop while !display.empty? && display.last.empty?
    display
  end

  def self.display_part(entity)
    content = entity[:content]
    if entity[:subtype] == 'html'
      format = 'html'
      lines = html_lines(content)
    elsif entity[:parameters].fetch('format', '').downcase == 'flowed'
      format = 'flowed'
      lines = flowed(content, entity[:parameters])
    else
      format = 'plain'
      lines = content.empty? ? [] : content.split("\n", -1)
    end
    lines.map! { |line| line.sub(/[ \t]+\z/, '') }
    quoted = lines.count { |line| line.start_with?('>') }
    signature_at = lines.rindex('--')
    signature = signature_at ? lines.length - signature_at - 1 : 0
    [format, lines, quoted, signature]
  end

  def self.assign_positions(roots, messages)
    roots.each_with_index do |root, index|
      stack = [[root, 0]]
      until stack.empty?
        node, depth = stack.pop
        if node.message
          node.message[:thread] = index + 1
          node.message[:depth] = depth
          node.message[:parent] = node.parent&.message
        end
        node.children.reverse_each { |child| stack << [child, depth + 1] }
      end
    end
    messages.each do |message|
      parent = message[:parent]
      if parent && message[:date] && parent[:date] && message[:date] < parent[:date]
        message[:problems] << "dated before parent message #{parent[:number]}"
      end
    end
  end

  def self.subject_notation(subject)
    subject.empty? ? '(no subject)' : subject
  end

  def self.date_notation(message)
    message[:date] ? Dates.notation(message[:date]) : 'invalid'
  end

  def self.thread_block(root, number)
    tree_lines = []
    dates = []
    senders = {}
    messages = 0
    maximum_depth = 0
    stack = [[root, 0, '', '']]
    until stack.empty?
      node, depth, prefix, stem = stack.pop
      maximum_depth = depth if depth > maximum_depth
      if node.message
        message = node.message
        messages += 1
        dates << message[:date] if message[:date]
        sender = message[:sender] ? message[:sender][:address] : '-'
        senders[sender] = true if message[:sender]
        notation = "[#{message[:number]}] #{date_notation(message)} #{sender} #{subject_notation(message[:subject])}"
      elsif node.subject
        notation = "[subject] #{node.subject}"
      else
        notation = "[missing] #{node.id}"
      end
      tree_lines << prefix + notation
      (node.children.length - 1).downto(0) do |index|
        last = index == node.children.length - 1
        child_prefix = stem + (last ? '`- ' : '+- ')
        child_stem = stem + (last ? '   ' : '|  ')
        stack << [node.children[index], depth + 1, child_prefix, child_stem]
      end
    end
    span = dates.empty? ? 'span -' : "span #{Dates.notation(dates.min)} .. #{Dates.notation(dates.max)}"
    ["thread #{number} messages #{messages} depth #{maximum_depth} senders #{senders.length}",
     span, "subject #{subject_notation(Threader.subject(root))}"] + tree_lines
  end

  def self.message_block(message)
    sender = message[:sender]
    from = if sender.nil?
             '-'
           elsif sender[:name]
             "#{sender[:name]} <#{sender[:address]}>"
           else
             sender[:address]
           end
    parent = message[:parent] ? message[:parent][:number] : '-'
    lines = ["message #{message[:number]}", "id #{message[:id].empty? ? '-' : message[:id]}",
             "date #{date_notation(message)}", "from #{from}",
             "to #{message[:to].empty? ? '-' : message[:to].join(', ')}",
             "cc #{message[:cc].empty? ? '-' : message[:cc].join(', ')}",
             "subject #{subject_notation(message[:subject])}",
             "refs #{message[:refs].empty? ? '-' : message[:refs].join(' ')}",
             "thread #{message[:thread]} depth #{message[:depth]} parent #{parent}"]
    stack = [message[:entity]]
    until stack.empty?
      entity = stack.pop
      line = "part #{entity[:part]} #{entity[:type]}/#{entity[:subtype]}"
      if entity[:children]
        entity[:children].reverse_each { |child| stack << child }
      else
        line << " #{entity[:content].length}"
        line << " #{entity[:disposition]}" if entity[:disposition]
        line << " \"#{entity[:filename]}\"" if entity[:filename] && !entity[:filename].empty?
      end
      lines << line
    end
    lines
  end

  def self.body_block(request, accepted)
    lines = ["request #{request}"]
    message = accepted[request]
    return lines + ['not found'] unless message

    parts = text_parts(message[:entity], true)
    lines << "message #{message[:number]} text parts #{parts.length}"
    parts.each do |entity|
      format, display, quoted, signature = display_part(entity)
      lines << "part #{entity[:part]} #{format} lines #{display.length} quoted #{quoted} signature #{signature}"
      display.each { |line| lines << (line.empty? ? '|' : '| ' + line) }
    end
    lines
  end

  def self.sender_lines(messages)
    groups = {}
    messages.each do |message|
      sender = message[:sender]
      next unless sender

      group = (groups[sender[:address]] ||= { name: '', messages: 0, threads: {}, first: nil, last: nil })
      group[:messages] += 1
      group[:threads][message[:thread]] = true
      group[:name] = sender[:name] if sender[:name]
      if message[:date]
        group[:first] = message[:date] if group[:first].nil? || message[:date] < group[:first]
        group[:last] = message[:date] if group[:last].nil? || message[:date] > group[:last]
      end
    end
    lines = ['address,name,messages,threads,first,last']
    groups.sort_by { |address, group| [-group[:messages], address] }.each do |address, group|
      name = group[:name]
      name = '"' + name.gsub('"', '""') + '"' if name.include?(',') || name.include?('"')
      first = group[:first] ? Dates.notation(group[:first]) : '-'
      last = group[:last] ? Dates.notation(group[:last]) : '-'
      lines << "#{address},#{name},#{group[:messages]},#{group[:threads].length},#{first},#{last}"
    end
    lines
  end

  def self.malformed_lines(messages)
    malformed = messages.count { |message| !message[:problems].empty? }
    total = messages.sum { |message| message[:problems].length }
    lines = ["messages #{messages.length} malformed #{malformed} problems #{total}"]
    messages.each do |message|
      message[:problems].each { |problem| lines << "message #{message[:number]}: #{problem}" }
    end
    lines
  end

  def self.write_blocks(name, blocks)
    text = blocks.map { |lines| lines.map { |line| line.sub(/[ \t]+\z/, '') }.join("\n") }.join("\n\n")
    File.binwrite("output/#{name}", text + "\n")
  end

  def self.run
    accepted = {}
    messages = read_mailbox.each_with_index.map { |lines, index| parse_message(lines, index + 1, accepted) }
    roots = Threader.build(messages)
    assign_positions(roots, messages)
    requests = File.binread('input/requests.txt').split("\n", -1)
    requests.pop
    FileUtils.mkdir_p('output')
    write_blocks('threads.txt', roots.each_with_index.map { |root, index| thread_block(root, index + 1) })
    write_blocks('messages.txt', messages.map { |message| message_block(message) })
    write_blocks('bodies.txt', requests.map { |request| body_block(request, accepted) })
    write_blocks('senders.csv', [sender_lines(messages)])
    write_blocks('malformed.txt', [malformed_lines(messages)])
  end
end

module Mime
  ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'

  def self.strict_base64(text)
    return nil unless (text.length % 4).zero?

    unpadded = text.sub(/=+\z/, '')
    return nil if text.length - unpadded.length >= 3

    result = +''.b
    buffer = 0
    bits = 0
    unpadded.each_char do |character|
      value = ALPHABET.index(character)
      return nil unless value

      buffer = (buffer << 6) | value
      bits += 6
      next if bits < 8

      bits -= 8
      result << ((buffer >> bits) & 255)
      buffer &= (1 << bits) - 1
    end
    result
  end

  def self.base64_body(text)
    decoded = strict_base64(text.delete(" \t\n"))
    return nil unless decoded

    decoded = decoded.gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    return nil unless decoded.each_byte.all? { |byte| byte == 9 || byte == 10 || byte.between?(32, 126) }

    decoded
  end

  def self.quoted_printable(text)
    lines = text.empty? ? [''] : text.split("\n", -1)
    result = +''.b
    error = false
    lines.each_with_index do |original, line_index|
      line = original.sub(/[ \t]+\z/, '')
      soft = line.end_with?('=')
      line = line[0...-1] if soft
      index = 0
      while index < line.length
        if line.getbyte(index) == 61
          pair = line[index + 1, 2]
          value = pair&.match?(/\A[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}\z/) ? pair.to_i(16) : nil
          if value && (value == 9 || value.between?(32, 126))
            result << value
            index += 3
            next
          end
          error = true
        end
        result << line.getbyte(index)
        index += 1
      end
      result << "\n" if !soft && line_index + 1 < lines.length
    end
    [result, error]
  end
end

module Threader
  class Container
    attr_accessor :id, :message, :parent, :children, :subject, :key

    def initialize(id = '')
      @id = id
      @message = nil
      @parent = nil
      @children = []
      @subject = nil
      @key = nil
    end
  end

  def self.ancestor?(candidate, node)
    while node
      return true if candidate.equal?(node)

      node = node.parent
    end
    false
  end

  def self.attach(child, parent)
    child.parent = parent
    parent.children << child
  end

  def self.prune(roots)
    replacements = {}
    stack = roots.reverse.map { |node| [node, true, false] }
    until stack.empty?
      node, root, visited = stack.pop
      unless visited
        stack << [node, root, true]
        node.children.reverse_each { |child| stack << [child, false, false] }
        next
      end
      children = []
      node.children.each { |child| children.concat(replacements.delete(child)) }
      node.children = children
      children.each { |child| child.parent = node }
      if node.message || (root && children.length >= 2)
        replacements[node] = [node]
      else
        children.each { |child| child.parent = node.parent }
        replacements[node] = children
        node.children = []
      end
    end
    roots.flat_map { |root| replacements.fetch(root) }
  end

  def self.sort(roots)
    nodes = []
    stack = roots.dup
    until stack.empty?
      node = stack.pop
      nodes << node
      node.children.each { |child| stack << child }
    end
    nodes.reverse_each do |node|
      node.children.sort_by!(&:key)
      node.key = node.message ? node.message[:key] : node.children.first.key
    end
    roots.sort_by!(&:key)
  end

  def self.subject(node)
    return node.subject unless node.subject.nil?

    node.message ? node.message[:base_subject] : node.children.first.message[:base_subject]
  end

  def self.merge_subjects(roots)
    groups = {}
    roots.each do |root|
      text = subject(root)
      next if text.empty?

      (groups[text] ||= []) << root
    end
    groups.each do |text, group|
      next if group.length < 2

      target = group.find { |root| root.message.nil? }
      unless target
        originals = group.select { |root| !root.message[:reply] }
        target = originals.first if originals.length == 1
      end
      unless target
        target = Container.new
        target.subject = text
        roots << target
      end
      group.each do |root|
        next if root.equal?(target)

        roots.delete(root)
        if root.message
          attach(root, target)
        else
          root.children.each { |child| attach(child, target) }
          root.children = []
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def self.build(messages)
    containers = []
    id_table = {}
    lookup = lambda do |id|
      unless id_table.key?(id)
        container = Container.new(id)
        id_table[id] = container
        containers << container
      end
      id_table.fetch(id)
    end
    messages.each do |message|
      if message[:id].empty?
        current = Container.new
        containers << current
      else
        current = lookup.call(message[:id])
      end
      current.message = message
      references = message[:refs].map { |id| lookup.call(id) }
      references.each_cons(2) do |first, second|
        attach(second, first) if second.parent.nil? && !ancestor?(second, first)
      end
      if current.parent
        current.parent.children.delete(current)
        current.parent = nil
      end
      attach(current, references.last) if !references.empty? && !ancestor?(current, references.last)
    end
    roots = prune(containers.select { |node| node.parent.nil? })
    sort(roots)
    merge_subjects(roots)
    sort(roots)
    roots
  end
end
